name: steam-chat-overlay
description: Stream chat overlay for OBS that merges Twitch, YouTube, Kick and TikTok live chat into one browser source

scripts.package: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=require('./package.json');const v=p.version;fs.mkdirSync('release',{recursive:true});fs.cpSync('server','release/server',{recursive:true});fs.cpSync('public','release/public',{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync('start.bat','release/start.bat');fs.copyFileSync('package.json','release/package.json');fs.copyFileSync('package-lock.json','release/package-lock.json');fs.copyFileSync('.env.example','release/.env.example');fs.copyFileSync('config.example.json','release/config.example.json');console.log('Packaged to release/');console.log('Run: npm install --production --prefix release');console.log('Then zip the release/ folder');"
